text:
Eve Nguyen: Heads-up: p99 for /v1/chat/generate spiked ~2x on the latency dashboard after we enabled streaming. p50/p95 look fine. Anyone else seeing this?

Maria Chen: Saw it. Hypothesis: dashboard moved from measuring TTFB -> TTTL when stream flag flipped. p99 is sensitive to the extra tail from long-running streams.

Ben Patel: Quick question — are we using gateway latency or worker-side total time? For streaming those differ a lot: gateway TTFB small, but TTTL (time-to-last-token) is larger.

Eve Nguyen: Good Q. Console query pulls `latency_ms` tagged by endpoint; ingestion pipeline also emits `latency_type` but our rollup default changed in last deploy.

Maria Chen: Repro snippet: ```SELECT quantile(0.99, latency_ms) FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat/generate' AND routing_tag='stable'``` That jumps when we include events with `finalized=true` (i.e., last-token events).

Ben Patel: Also note we accidentally included quota-abort events earlier — those are short and skew p50 down but can create weird p99 gaps when mixed with long streams.

Jonas: UX idea: surface both measures. Add a small selector: measure: [ttfb | ttl | gateway | worker]. Default stays `ttl` but make it explicit in the pill so people know which latency the percentile refers to.

deploy-bot: rollout streaming-responses v12 -> 100% in eu-west-1 (2024-10-03 15:22:34 UTC) :rocket:

Maria Chen: Minor telemetry ask: when computing percentiles, exclude keep-alive / ping messages and any housekeeping pings. We had heartbeats counted previously which biased p50 downward.

Eve Nguyen: +1. Also add a short doc blurb on the console: "p99 here refers to TTTL (time-to-last-token) unless you change the measure". That should reduce pager noise.

Ben Patel: I'll open an issue to: (1) add measure selector to console, (2) add an 'aggregation source' tooltip, (3) add a diff view to compare old vs new calculation over the last 7 days.

Maria Chen: sgtm. Also callout that streaming vs non-streaming clients will naturally shift percentile shapes — add that to the doc note.

Eve Nguyen: Thanks — assigning @Ben to the console PR and @Maria to update the dashboard queries. :thumbsup:
